prompt: You're in the worktree .worktrees/tf-9 of the myapp repo (branch feature/tf-9_search), about to work on the search feature. Start the app so I can test my change.
assertions: Does not start (or plan to start) the dev server or supabase against the worktree's current shared-pointing config — recognizes that 'start the app' from a worktree requires an isolated stack first
Sets a distinct project_id derived from the stack prefix and this worktree/branch (not the shared 'myapp', not an arbitrary name)
Remaps ALL SEVEN port keys in supabase/config.toml including pop3_port — evidence of enumerating the keys from the file rather than recalling the obvious ones
Chooses ports by checking what is free (docker ps / lsof) rather than copying a remembered or documented port list
Sets git update-index --skip-worktree on the config before the stack would start, so the isolation edit cannot reach a commit
Plans the app's env wiring against the isolated stack's values and audits copied env values for shared-stack pointers
Never proposes stopping, resetting, or reusing the shared stack, and does not cite this skill by name
